value.rationale: The motivating work shows collective jumps alone do not protect its many-qubit dark states against Hamiltonian mixing. A complete engineered-graph criterion and surprising sparse-star construction recover an exponentially large exact DFS; the natural perfect-matching variance provides a constructive diagnostic for every forbidden coupling/field pattern. This is a structural all-N result, not Catalan recounting or an arbitrary small numerical invariant.
